summary: Frontend-only verification of ThemeFlourish refinements — Cyber neon lasers + CRT scanline, Summer bouncing beach balls, Reaper vapor ghosts (div-only, no SVG), and Coffee-Shop latte/audio. All four scenarios PASS on preview URL with zero console errors.

dark_ghosts_v2.status: PASS — cartoon SVG ghosts replaced with 3-layer div vapor apparitions

critical_code_review_comments: ThemeFlourish.jsx cleanly extends the FLOURISH_THEMES set with 'cyber' and correctly skips it in the deck variant along with fantasy/dark — matches problem statement.
GhostRise now uses 3 layered radial-gradient divs with parent blur(6px) — no <svg> in dark flourish, confirmed at runtime.
CyberLasers renders exactly 5 90deg linear-gradient beams + 1 repeating-linear-gradient scanline overlay (6 direct children) as specified.

BeachBalls renders 5 conic-gradient circles with 6-slice striped pattern; bounce keyframe uses times [0, 0.32, 0.52, 0.72, 0.86, 1] against 5-easing array — Framer Motion accepts this and it works, but note per-segment easing arrays must have exactly len(keyframes)-1 entries (5 for 6 stops) — correct here.
shuffle-cafe.wav (regenerated 1005 KB, 11.4s) still fetches from public/ with 200 — no caching regressions.
seed_data_creation: Per-theme localStorage seeding via add_init_script: ff_theme, ff_theme_chosen=1, ff_theme_hint_seen=1, ff_deal_taps=0, ff_rare_at=10, ff_guided_done=1, ff_intro_seen=1, ff_muted removed. Note: intro guided-flow modal appeared on first load and had to be dismissed via 'Skip intro' click before spin-roulette-button became clickable — pre-existing behaviour, not a regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL shows guided intro modal on fresh sessions overlaying the deal button — click 'Skip intro' (or wait for skip selector) before filling zip-input. Setting ff_guided_done=1 in localStorage did NOT bypass the modal on preview; the skip click is required. Otherwise iteration_45 recipe still valid: zip=90210 + Enter, wait ~5s for spin-roulette-button enable, click; poll [data-testid=deck-flourish] and [data-testid=theme-flourish] every 100ms. For cyber theme, deck variant intentionally has no deck-flourish (only the pre-existing cyber neon pulse component, not part of ThemeFlourish). Dark theme also has no deck-flourish (skeleton hands own that moment).
